name: Kenji Tanaka
household: Lives alone; occasional visits from married sister
psychographics: Values precision and efficiency; treats shop time as billable hours, dislikes waste.
current_solutions: Uses a combination of Shopify POS for inventory and a local B2B wholesale directory app called 'Mirai' to source components.
frustration: Spent 20 minutes yesterday at 2:14 PM trying to update the 'Mirai' app on his iPhone; the update stalled at 98%, forcing a factory reset of the app and loss of his offline product catalogue.
decision_style: Reads technical specs and user reviews on Japanese e-commerce sites for several days before committing to a new tool; rarely buys based on advertising alone.
voice: Blunt and direct; speaks in concise sentences, often skipping pleasantaries when busy. Uses technical jargon like 'turnaround time' and 'stock turn' naturally.
